records.title: FORM 10-K FOR THE YEAR ENDED DECEMBER 31, 2024
records.text: Consolidated net sales in 2024 totaled $1,286.7 million, a 3.5% increase as compared to consolidated net sales of $1,243.6 million in 2023.

records.title: FORM 10-K FOR THE YEAR ENDED DECEMBER 31, 2024
records.text: In Australia, there are signals of reduced demand as customers are delaying equipment orders or moving to rental units.

records.title: FORM 10-K FOR THE YEAR ENDED DECEMBER 31, 2024
records.text: EMEA volumes were impacted by weak economic conditions and a small contribution from backlog reduction.

records.title: FORM 10-K FOR THE YEAR ENDED DECEMBER 31, 2024
records.text: We are closely monitoring challenging business conditions in APAC, especially in China, which continues to experience market saturation, leading to decreased demand for our mid-tier products and heightened pricing pressures in the region.

records.title: FORM 10-K FOR THE YEAR ENDED DECEMBER 31, 2024
records.text: Net cash provided by operating activities in 2024 was $89.7 million compared to net cash provided by operating activities of $188.4 million in 2023.
